title: Rosuvastatin calcium and pravastatin sodium regulate the antioxidant system in zebrafish liver through the PI3K/Nrf2/ARE signaling pathway.
authors: Xie, Y I N G; Wang, X I A N R U I; Mu, Q U A N L I N G; Ding, C U N B A O
journal: Comparative biochemistry and physiology. Toxicology & pharmacology : CBP
one_liner_zh: 该文研究他汀类药物对斑马鱼肝脏抗氧化系统的影响，涉及PI3K/Nrf2/ARE通路及分子对接，但核心是毒理学表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，方法仅简单对接，与课题关联微弱。
abstract: Rosuvastatin calcium (ROV) and pravastatin sodium (PRA) are common drugs used for the treatment and prevention of cardiovascular diseases. They have been frequently detected in the global aquatic environment, but their toxic effects and molecular mechanisms on the antioxidant system of fish remain unclear. In this study, zebrafish were exposed to ROV or PRA for 48 h to investigate their effects on the hepatic antioxidant response system of zebrafish and the possible underlying molecular mechanisms. The results showed that after exposure to the two drugs, the levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS), glutathione (GSH), and malondialdehyde (MDA) increased, while the activities of catalase (CAT) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) were inhibited. Exposure to ROV (5 mg/L) upregulated the activities of glutathione peroxidase (GPx) and glutathione S-transferase (GST), as well as the mRNA levels of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K) and CAT. However, the protein levels of nuclear factor erythroid 2-like protein (Nrf2) and SOD were suppressed. Exposure to PRA (10 mg/L) also increased the mRNA levels of PI3K, CAT, and GPx, while inhibiting Nrf2 and SOD proteins. The inhibitory effects on Nrf2 and SOD proteins were reversed after the addition of the PI3K activator 740YP. Molecular docking showed that both ROV and PRA could bind stably to PI3K. In conclusion, both ROV and PRA can induce hepatic oxidative damage in zebrafish, and the mechanism may be related to the disruption of the PI3K-mediated Nrf2/ARE pathway.
abstract_zh: 瑞舒伐他汀钙（ROV）和普伐他汀钠（PRA）是用于治疗和预防心血管疾病的常用药物。它们在全球水生环境中被频繁检出，但其对鱼类抗氧化系统的毒性效应及分子机制尚不清楚。本研究将斑马鱼暴露于ROV或PRA 48小时，以探究其对斑马鱼肝脏抗氧化反应系统的影响及可能的潜在分子机制。结果表明，暴露于这两种药物后，活性氧（ROS）、谷胱甘肽（GSH）和丙二醛（MDA）水平升高，而过氧化氢酶（CAT）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的活性受到抑制。暴露于ROV（5 mg/L）上调了谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）和谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）的活性，以及磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）和CAT的mRNA水平。然而，核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）和SOD的蛋白水平受到抑制。暴露于PRA（10 mg/L）也增加了PI3K、CAT和GPx的mRNA水平，同时抑制了Nrf2和SOD蛋白。添加PI3K激活剂740YP后，对Nrf2和SOD蛋白的抑制作用被逆转。分子对接显示，ROV和PRA均能稳定结合PI3K。总之，ROV和PRA均可诱导斑马鱼肝脏氧化损伤，其机制可能与破坏PI3K介导的Nrf2/ARE通路有关。
